SELECT DISTINCT ep.name || ' – ' || eo.name || ' (' || CASE eo.offer_type WHEN 'BASE' THEN 'Base' WHEN 'HC_HP' THEN 'Heures creuses' WHEN 'WEEKEND' THEN 'Week-end'
    WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN 'HC nuit et week-end' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN 'Saisonnière' WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN 'Tempo'
    ELSE eo.offer_type END || ')'
FROM energy_offers eo JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
WHERE eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND eo.is_active AND ep.is_active AND eo.offer_type IN ('BASE', 'HC_HP', 'WEEKEND', 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND', 'SEASONAL', 'TEMPO')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Jours de courbe de charge
panels.description: Jours de la période choisie couverts par la courbe de charge Enedis. Les coûts sont ramenés à une année : avec moins de 12 mois, le résultat dépend des saisons couvertes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH pts AS (
  -- Courbe de charge : valeur = puissance moyenne (W) sur le pas, pas de 30 ou 15 min selon le jour
  SELECT c.date,
    c.interval_start::time AS t,
    extract(isodow FROM c.date)::int AS dow,
    extract(month FROM c.date)::int AS mois,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    c.value / 1000.0 * 24.0 / count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.usage_point_id, c.date) AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed'
    AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
                   AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), saisie AS (
  -- Plages HC Enedis de l'utilisateur, ex. 22:00-06:00 ou 01:30-07:30;12:30-14:30
  SELECT split_part(p, '-', 1)::time AS deb, split_part(p, '-', 2)::time AS fin
  FROM unnest(string_to_array(replace('$plages_hc', ' ', ''), ';')) AS p
  WHERE p LIKE '%-%'
), plages AS (
  SELECT deb, fin FROM saisie
  UNION ALL SELECT '22:00'::time, '06:00'::time WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saisie)
), cat AS (
  -- Les points sont regroupés par catégorie horaire : le calcul par offre reste léger
  SELECT 
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plages pl
            WHERE (pl.deb < pl.fin AND x.t >= pl.deb AND x.t < pl.fin)
               OR (pl.deb >= pl.fin AND (x.t >= pl.deb OR x.t < pl.fin))) AS hc,
    (x.t >= '22:00' OR x.t < '06:00') AS hc_tempo,
    (x.t >= '23:00' OR x.t < '06:00') AS nuit,
    x.dow >= 6 AS we,
    x.mois IN (11, 12, 1, 2, 3) AS hiver,
    COALESCE(td.color::text, 'BLUE') AS couleur,
    sum(x.kwh) AS kwh
  FROM pts x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days td ON td.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
), info AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT date) AS jours, sum(kwh) AS kwh, min(date) AS debut, max(date) AS fin FROM pts
), offres AS (
  -- Grille actuelle de chaque offre à la puissance choisie
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ep.name, eo.name, eo.offer_type) eo.*, ep.name AS fournisseur
  FROM energy_offers eo
  JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
  WHERE eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND eo.is_active AND ep.is_active
    AND eo.offer_type IN ('BASE', 'HC_HP', 'WEEKEND', 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND', 'SEASONAL', 'TEMPO')
    AND (eo.valid_from IS NULL OR eo.valid_from <= now())
  ORDER BY ep.name, eo.name, eo.offer_type, (eo.valid_to IS NULL OR eo.valid_to > now()) DESC,
           eo.valid_from DESC NULLS LAST
), prix AS (
  SELECT o.fournisseur, o.name AS offre, o.offer_type, o.subscription_price,
    cat.kwh,
    CASE o.offer_type
      WHEN 'BASE' THEN CASE WHEN cat.we THEN COALESCE(o.base_price_weekend, o.base_price) ELSE o.base_price END
      WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN CASE WHEN cat.we OR cat.nuit THEN o.hc_price ELSE o.hp_price END
      WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN CASE WHEN cat.hiver
        THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price_winter ELSE o.hp_price_winter END
        ELSE CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price_summer ELSE o.hp_price_summer END END
      WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN CASE cat.couleur
        WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
        WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
        ELSE              CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END END
      ELSE -- HC_HP et WEEKEND : HC/HP, avec des prix week-end éventuels
        CASE WHEN cat.we
          THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN COALESCE(o.hc_price_weekend, o.hc_price) ELSE COALESCE(o.hp_price_weekend, o.hp_price) END
          ELSE CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price ELSE o.hp_price END END
    END AS prix
  FROM offres o CROSS JOIN cat
), couts AS (
  -- Une offre dont la grille est incomplète est écartée plutôt que sous-estimée
  SELECT fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price, sum(kwh * prix) AS energie
  FROM prix
  GROUP BY fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price
  HAVING bool_and(prix IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT jours AS "Jours" FROM info

  WHERE eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND eo.is_active AND ep.is_active
    AND eo.offer_type IN ('BASE', 'HC_HP', 'WEEKEND', 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND', 'SEASONAL', 'TEMPO')
    AND (eo.valid_from IS NULL OR eo.valid_from <= now())
  ORDER BY ep.name, eo.name, eo.offer_type, (eo.valid_to IS NULL OR eo.valid_to > now()) DESC,
           eo.valid_from DESC NULLS LAST
), prix AS (
  SELECT o.fournisseur, o.name AS offre, o.offer_type, o.subscription_price,
    cat.kwh,
    CASE o.offer_type
      WHEN 'BASE' THEN CASE WHEN cat.we THEN COALESCE(o.base_price_weekend, o.base_price) ELSE o.base_price END
      WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN CASE WHEN cat.we OR cat.nuit THEN o.hc_price ELSE o.hp_price END
      WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN CASE WHEN cat.hiver
        THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price_winter ELSE o.hp_price_winter END
        ELSE CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price_summer ELSE o.hp_price_summer END END
      WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN CASE cat.couleur
        WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
        WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
        ELSE              CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END END
      ELSE -- HC_HP et WEEKEND : HC/HP, avec des prix week-end éventuels
        CASE WHEN cat.we
          THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN COALESCE(o.hc_price_weekend, o.hc_price) ELSE COALESCE(o.hp_price_weekend, o.hp_price) END
          ELSE CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price ELSE o.hp_price END END
    END AS prix
  FROM offres o CROSS JOIN cat
), couts AS (
  -- Une offre dont la grille est incomplète est écartée plutôt que sous-estimée
  SELECT fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price, sum(kwh * prix) AS energie
  FROM prix
  GROUP BY fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price
  HAVING bool_and(prix IS NOT NULL)
), annuel AS (
  SELECT c.fournisseur || ' – ' || c.offre || ' (' || CASE c.offer_type WHEN 'BASE' THEN 'Base' WHEN 'HC_HP' THEN 'Heures creuses' WHEN 'WEEKEND' THEN 'Week-end'
    WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN 'HC nuit et week-end' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN 'Saisonnière' WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN 'Tempo'
    ELSE c.offer_type END || ')' AS nom, c.fournisseur, c.offre, c.offer_type,
    c.subscription_price * 12 AS abo_an,
    c.energie * 365.0 / NULLIF(i.jours, 0) AS energie_an,
    c.subscription_price * 12 + c.energie * 365.0 / NULLIF(i.jours, 0) AS total_an
  FROM couts c, info i
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (offer_type) CASE offer_type WHEN 'BASE' THEN 'Base' WHEN 'HC_HP' THEN 'Heures creuses' WHEN 'WEEKEND' THEN 'Week-end'
    WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN 'HC nuit et week-end' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN 'Saisonnière' WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN 'Tempo'
    ELSE offer_type END AS "Type", fournisseur AS "Fournisseur", offre AS "Offre",
  total_an AS "Total / an", total_an - (SELECT min(total_an) FROM annuel WHERE nom = '$offre_actuelle') AS "Écart avec l'offre actuelle"
FROM annuel
ORDER BY offer_type, total_an

panels.title: Coût mois par mois : offre actuelle et meilleure offre

targets.rawSql:
WITH pts AS (
  -- Courbe de charge : valeur = puissance moyenne (W) sur le pas, pas de 30 ou 15 min selon le jour
  SELECT c.date,
    c.interval_start::time AS t,
    extract(isodow FROM c.date)::int AS dow,
    extract(month FROM c.date)::int AS mois,
    ((c.date + c.interval_start::time) - interval '6 hours')::date AS tempo_date,
    c.value / 1000.0 * 24.0 / count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.usage_point_id, c.date) AS kwh
  FROM consumption_data c
  WHERE c.granularity = 'detailed'
    AND c.date BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
                   AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
), saisie AS (
  -- Plages HC Enedis de l'utilisateur, ex. 22:00-06:00 ou 01:30-07:30;12:30-14:30
  SELECT split_part(p, '-', 1)::time AS deb, split_part(p, '-', 2)::time AS fin
  FROM unnest(string_to_array(replace('$plages_hc', ' ', ''), ';')) AS p
  WHERE p LIKE '%-%'
), plages AS (
  SELECT deb, fin FROM saisie
  UNION ALL SELECT '22:00'::time, '06:00'::time WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saisie)
), cat AS (
  -- Les points sont regroupés par catégorie horaire : le calcul par offre reste léger
  SELECT date_trunc('month', x.date)::date AS mois_d, 
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plages pl
            WHERE (pl.deb < pl.fin AND x.t >= pl.deb AND x.t < pl.fin)
               OR (pl.deb >= pl.fin AND (x.t >= pl.deb OR x.t < pl.fin))) AS hc,
    (x.t >= '22:00' OR x.t < '06:00') AS hc_tempo,
    (x.t >= '23:00' OR x.t < '06:00') AS nuit,
    x.dow >= 6 AS we,
    x.mois IN (11, 12, 1, 2, 3) AS hiver,
    COALESCE(td.color::text, 'BLUE') AS couleur,
    sum(x.kwh) AS kwh
  FROM pts x
  LEFT JOIN tempo_days td ON td.id = to_char(x.tempo_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
), info AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT date) AS jours, sum(kwh) AS kwh, min(date) AS debut, max(date) AS fin FROM pts
), offres AS (
  -- Grille actuelle de chaque offre à la puissance choisie
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ep.name, eo.name, eo.offer_type) eo.*, ep.name AS fournisseur
  FROM energy_offers eo
  JOIN energy_providers ep ON ep.id = eo.provider_id
  WHERE eo.power_kva = $puissance_kva AND eo.is_active AND ep.is_active
    AND eo.offer_type IN ('BASE', 'HC_HP', 'WEEKEND', 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND', 'SEASONAL', 'TEMPO')
    AND (eo.valid_from IS NULL OR eo.valid_from <= now())
  ORDER BY ep.name, eo.name, eo.offer_type, (eo.valid_to IS NULL OR eo.valid_to > now()) DESC,
           eo.valid_from DESC NULLS LAST
), prix AS (
  SELECT o.fournisseur, o.name AS offre, o.offer_type, o.subscription_price, mois_d,
    cat.kwh,
    CASE o.offer_type
      WHEN 'BASE' THEN CASE WHEN cat.we THEN COALESCE(o.base_price_weekend, o.base_price) ELSE o.base_price END
      WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN CASE WHEN cat.we OR cat.nuit THEN o.hc_price ELSE o.hp_price END
      WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN CASE WHEN cat.hiver
        THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price_winter ELSE o.hp_price_winter END
        ELSE CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price_summer ELSE o.hp_price_summer END END
      WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN CASE cat.couleur
        WHEN 'RED'   THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_red_hc   ELSE o.tempo_red_hp   END
        WHEN 'WHITE' THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_white_hc ELSE o.tempo_white_hp END
        ELSE              CASE WHEN cat.hc_tempo THEN o.tempo_blue_hc  ELSE o.tempo_blue_hp  END END
      ELSE -- HC_HP et WEEKEND : HC/HP, avec des prix week-end éventuels
        CASE WHEN cat.we
          THEN CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN COALESCE(o.hc_price_weekend, o.hc_price) ELSE COALESCE(o.hp_price_weekend, o.hp_price) END
          ELSE CASE WHEN cat.hc THEN o.hc_price ELSE o.hp_price END END
    END AS prix
  FROM offres o CROSS JOIN cat
), couts AS (
  -- Une offre dont la grille est incomplète est écartée plutôt que sous-estimée
  SELECT fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price, mois_d, sum(kwh * prix) AS energie
  FROM prix
  GROUP BY fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price, mois_d
  HAVING bool_and(prix IS NOT NULL)
), annuel AS (
  SELECT c.fournisseur || ' – ' || c.offre || ' (' || CASE c.offer_type WHEN 'BASE' THEN 'Base' WHEN 'HC_HP' THEN 'Heures creuses' WHEN 'WEEKEND' THEN 'Week-end'
    WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN 'HC nuit et week-end' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN 'Saisonnière' WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN 'Tempo'
    ELSE c.offer_type END || ')' AS nom, c.fournisseur, c.offre, c.offer_type,
    c.subscription_price * 12 AS abo_an,
    c.energie * 365.0 / NULLIF(i.jours, 0) AS energie_an,
    c.subscription_price * 12 + c.energie * 365.0 / NULLIF(i.jours, 0) AS total_an
  FROM (SELECT fournisseur, offre, offer_type, subscription_price, sum(energie) AS energie FROM couts GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) c, info i
), meilleure AS (SELECT nom FROM annuel ORDER BY total_an LIMIT 1)
SELECT mois_d::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris' AS time,
  sum(energie + subscription_price) FILTER (WHERE fournisseur || ' – ' || offre || ' (' || CASE offer_type WHEN 'BASE' THEN 'Base' WHEN 'HC_HP' THEN 'Heures creuses' WHEN 'WEEKEND' THEN 'Week-end'
    WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN 'HC nuit et week-end' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN 'Saisonnière' WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN 'Tempo'
    ELSE offer_type END || ')' = '$offre_actuelle') AS "Offre actuelle",
  sum(energie + subscription_price) FILTER (WHERE fournisseur || ' – ' || offre || ' (' || CASE offer_type WHEN 'BASE' THEN 'Base' WHEN 'HC_HP' THEN 'Heures creuses' WHEN 'WEEKEND' THEN 'Week-end'
    WHEN 'HC_NUIT_WEEKEND' THEN 'HC nuit et week-end' WHEN 'SEASONAL' THEN 'Saisonnière' WHEN 'TEMPO' THEN 'Tempo'
    ELSE offer_type END || ')' = (SELECT nom FROM meilleure)) AS "Meilleure offre"
FROM couts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

options.content:
- **Votre consommation réelle** : la courbe de charge Enedis (pas de 30 ou 15 minutes) sur la période choisie en haut à droite, **ramenée à une année**. Avec moins de 12 mois de données, le résultat dépend des saisons couvertes (l'hiver pèse lourd en Tempo).
- **Les tarifs actuels** de toutes les offres de la base MyElectricalData à votre puissance, abonnement compris (TTC). Une offre à la grille incomplète est écartée ; l'EJP n'est pas comparée (jours EJP inconnus).
- **Heures creuses** : vos plages Enedis (variable « Plages HC », visibles sur votre facture ou dans l'interface MyElectricalData) pour les offres HC ; 22 h - 6 h pour Tempo ; 23 h - 6 h et tout le week-end pour les offres « nuit et week-end ». **Tempo** : les vraies couleurs des jours de la période.
- C'est une **estimation pour comparer** : les prix évoluent, et votre consommation changerait peut-être avec une autre offre (décaler des usages en heures creuses, éviter les jours rouges…).
